description: An RRH1 frame (the sender seed's P2P_ID, then six LAN_ADDR entries, type 0x09): a globally routable address, an IPv6 link-local one, a port with a leading zero (not canonical), two good ones (the second with every flag bit set) and a third good one past the limit of 2. Each bad or extra entry is dropped alone with an RRH1_MALFORMED debug log; the frame, its P2P_ID and the two good entries (flag bits cleared) are kept
name: LAN_ADDR entries that break §16
